content: Return requests must be submitted within 14 days from date of delivery. Items must be unworn, unwashed, in original packaging with tags attached.
Size or style exchange requests must be submitted within 14 days from date of delivery. Return shipping is covered by the customer.
Refunds processed within 5-7 business days after 2-3 business days warehouse inspection. Original shipping fees are non-refundable.
Orders are verified, packed, and dispatched within 1-2 business days excluding public holidays.

exceptions: Dispatched orders must follow return policy
content: Orders may be modified or cancelled within 12 hours of placement provided the parcel has not yet been handed to the courier.
